login.title: Ops Console Sign In
login.subtitle: Internal operators only. Accounts are issued by administrators.
login.noRegisterHint: Public sign-up is not available. Contact an operations administrator for an account.

error.disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact an operations administrator.
error.network: Network connection failed. Check your network and try again.
error.contractMismatch: The frontend and backend API contract versions are incompatible, so business pages cannot load. Ask an administrator to align the deployed versions and try again.
error.noPermission: This account has no ops console permission. Ask an administrator to assign an ops role.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.server: Service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

fallback.forbiddenDescription: Your account cannot access this page. Contact an operations administrator to request access.
fallback.notFoundTitle: Page not found or not accessible
fallback.notFoundDescription: Check the address. If the link is correct, your account may not have permission for this page.

placeholder.pending: This page will be delivered in a later iteration. Only the route entry and menu contract exist now.
placeholder.authorityNote: Hiding menus and pages only improves experience. Real authorization is enforced by the server on action codes.
